name: pomi
description: A self-hostable focus timer with intentions, tasks, and optional AI assistance.
author: William Guinaudie

scripts.test:operations: node --test scripts/codex-worktree-environment.test.mjs scripts/dev-database-paths.test.mjs scripts/dev-ports.test.mjs scripts/github-app-auth.test.mjs scripts/http-client.test.mjs scripts/local-env.test.mjs scripts/migrate-private-radar.test.mjs scripts/migrate-private-pulls.test.mjs scripts/path-safety.test.mjs scripts/radar-automation-lock.test.mjs scripts/run-parallel-releases.test.mjs scripts/xml-resource-text.test.mjs && ./scripts/run-pomi-sentry.test.sh
scripts.test:business: pnpm test:build && vitest run --coverage && node ./scripts/verify-coverage.mjs --mode=business && node ./scripts/verify-business-logic-ownership.mjs
scripts.test:ci: pnpm -r run build && pnpm lint && pnpm test:native && pnpm test:business && pnpm test:public-snapshot
scripts.test:e2e:stress:focused: sh -c 'if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then echo "Pass a focused Playwright filter, for example: pnpm test:e2e:stress:focused -- -g \"accepted-action FIFO\""; exit 2; fi; CI=1 POMI_E2E_ADMIN_REPEAT_COUNT=50 PLAYWRIGHT_CI_WORKERS=1 PLAYWRIGHT_FULLY_PARALLEL=0 ./scripts/run-e2e.sh --workers=1 --repeat-each=50 "$@"' --
scripts.test:assistant:live: pnpm --filter @pomi/shared build && pnpm --filter @pomi/backend build && NODE_PATH=packages/backend/dist RUN_ASSISTANT_LIVE_TESTS=1 node --test packages/backend/test/assistant-live.test.cjs
scripts.docker:migration: sh -c 'docker exec -it pomi-backend-1 sh -c "cd packages/backend && pnpm migration:run"' -
scripts.docker:migration:revert: sh -c 'docker exec -it pomi-backend-1 sh -c "cd packages/backend && pnpm migration:revert"'
scripts.db:clear-test-data: docker exec -it pomi-backend-1 sh -c "cd packages/backend && pnpm db:clear"
scripts.build:macos: node ./scripts/run-with-local-env.mjs --profile release -- sh -c 'cd packages/frontend && NODE_ENV=production VITE_DEBUG_PANEL_ENABLED=false pnpm tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --no-sign'
scripts.build:android: pnpm native:prepare && node ./scripts/run-with-local-env.mjs --profile release -- sh -c 'cd packages/frontend && NODE_ENV=production VITE_DEBUG_PANEL_ENABLED=false pnpm tauri android build'
scripts.build:wear: pnpm native:prepare && node ./scripts/run-with-local-env.mjs --profile release -- sh -c 'cd packages/frontend/src-tauri/gen/android && ./gradlew --settings-file wear.settings.gradle :wear:assembleDebug --no-daemon'
scripts.build:windows: node ./scripts/run-with-local-env.mjs --profile release -- sh -c 'cd packages/frontend && NODE_ENV=production VITE_DEBUG_PANEL_ENABLED=false pnpm tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --runner cargo-xwin'
